    AI Horsey Editor

    A beginner’s guide

    Start hereThe screenGet a horse inChange the horseInside a geneUndo & locksPreviewVariationsWhat the game seesPhoneShortcutsGood to know

    Start here

    This editor builds a horse from its DNA: 40 short lines of letters (A, C, G, T). The DNA is the load-bearing part of everything here. Every slider, colour and tag is read from it, and every change you make is written back into it. Copy the DNA and you have copied the horse.

    The quick way in:

    1. Click 📋 Paste DNA (or pick a horse in Pop or your DNA Library).
    2. Move the controls on the left and watch the horse on the right.
    3. Click 📋 Copy DNA and paste it into the game, or 💾 Save it to your library.

    The screen at a glance

    Get a horse in

    • 📋 Paste DNA: takes 40 DNA lines, a DNA code or a ?dna= link from your clipboard.
    • Raw Genome (side panel): paste or type the DNA, then Apply.
    • Pop: click a population for a fresh random horse of that kind.
    • DNA Library: click a saved horse.
    • ☰ → Randomize makes a random horse; Reset goes back to the plain one.

    Whatever you load becomes the “as loaded” horse. It is the load-bearing reference for the changed markers, for Revert and for the compare button.

    Change the horse

    Coloured pills tell you more: amber is a note on what the value does; green, red and yellow are race habits the game gives this horse (good, bad or mixed).

    Look inside a gene

    Each gene has two letters, one from each strand. The letters are coloured like in the game: T red, G green, C blue, A yellow. The bright letter on the chip is the dominant one.

    Undo, changes and locks

    Lock the genes that are load-bearing for your design first, then Randomize or try Variations freely: they leave the locked genes alone.

    The preview

    Variations: ideas for the next step

    What the game sees

    The build tags (size, legs, neck) are load-bearing for the game: the race simulator, the sounds and the species all come from them.

    On a phone

    Keyboard shortcuts

    /Filter the controls (Enter next match, Esc clear)
    Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+YUndo / redo
    B (hold)Show the horse as loaded
    PPreview: picture → physics → running
    [ ]Previous / next section
    ?This guide

    Good to know

    • Nothing is lost while you experiment: Undo goes back up to 200 steps.
    • The page address carries your DNA (?dna=…). Bookmark it, or send it to a friend.
    • A custom genes.xml / pop.xml (Custom Data panel) changes every tool in this browser until you reset it.
    • Some genes change nothing you can see but are load-bearing in a race: speed, stamina and race habits live there. The tags and the coloured pills point them out.
